section_summary.extract_value: This section details the statistical analysis methodology, which involved a serial multiple mediation model predicting the impact of gratitude on physical health, mediated by loneliness and perceived stress. The analysis was performed using PROCESS for IBM SPSS Statistics 23, employing bootstrap significance tests with a 95% confidence interval and 5000 bootstrap samples. The final sample size for this analysis was n = 607, and the approach was deemed appropriate due to sufficient power and completely random missing data.
